groups.title: Terminal non-save, stable receipts and in-flight safety
groups.acceptance: Certify per-attempt terminality; stable replay/fingerprint conflicts for terminal outcomes; delayed original plus rejected reconciliation must not enable a fresh attempt while late commit remains possible.

groups.title: Already-open WebSocket grant lifetime
groups.acceptance: Enforce approved expiry, session-end grace and revocation on already-open sockets, resync and broadcast; test participant/facilitator variants without inventing a new lifetime policy.

groups.title: Lost join acknowledgement creates another participant
groups.acceptance: Keep the pending join key and immutable payload for uncertain unchanged retry; one logical join must recover the same participant and count once. Define explicit safe room/payload-change behavior.

groups.title: Monotonic snapshots, join visibility and truthful Live
groups.acceptance: Join-only count changes must advance coherent revisioned snapshots and publish after commit. Reject stale HTTP as well as WS state. Mark Live only after an authorized fresh snapshot; cover delayed HTTP, equal-revision resync and reconnect.

groups.title: Saved outcome incorrectly carries into the next question
groups.acceptance: Scope outcome/draft/read-only state to authoritative question and own response. A new unanswered question is not saved and is usable. Preserve unknown earlier attempts separately; verify rating-to-poll, return to answered question and unknown-during-transition.
